method: Search all 100 canonical tuition/fee notes for boarding, board, residential and dorm; inspect the five named official-school tuition pages and published indexed content.

findings.evidence: Canonical official-source tuition note: grade 12 tuition 49000, room/board 24000 to 35000; year unspecified. Boarding floor 73000; occupancy package high 84000 excludes unresolved mandatory fees.
2026-27 upper school table lists day 45800, boarding 63000.
2026-27 upper school domestic boarding total 81750 includes tuition, boarding supplement, facilities and food; textbooks/supplies 500–800 extra.

2026-27 seven-day tuition 86230, five-day 68984, student fee 7500 for either. Graduation fee is excluded from boarding package; official tuition page prices grade-12 graduation at 1250. Seven-day default avoids silently treating five-day accommodation as seven-day. Five-day price is retained as an explicit alternative field.

findings.school: Princeton International School of Mathematics and Science
findings.evidence: Official legacy page search-indexed table lists 2026/27 boarding 70000, day 51000. Direct legacy URL returned 404; redesigned Fall 2027 affordability page has no rate table. Price is explicitly a 2026-27 historical published benchmark, not a Fall 2027 quote.
Current 2026-27 official tuition page lists Middle/Upper School 40894 with no boarding rate or current boarding offer. No boarding rate inferred from historical reputation.

Canonical tuition note separately mentions undated publisher-reported boarding 80000 and day 31000. No official boarding rate verified by this audit. Retained as an unresolved publisher-only lead, not silently represented as official verified tuition.
